title: Weapon Leveling x Tetra Compat
description: This Mod adds Compatibility between Tetra and Lukas' Weapon Leveling
body:
Modularize and Level!


Features

Keep Leveling Data
Your levels and the progress will get saved when changing parts of your weapon

Item Leveling
All modular weapons are fully levelable through this mod!


Why should I use this mod?
If you have leveled your weapon before modifying it, your progress will now persist. Without this mod, it would get reset to level 0. This was a feature in older versions of WL, so if you are using WeaponLeveling below 3.0.0, this mod is not needed.
The decision to split it into a new mod was made to make future updates faster and more streamlined.

Another reason to use the mod is the added compatibility for all weapon types of Tetra. They are also easily customizable just by changing the levelable json files of each weapon type.




This is an official Addon for Weapon Leveling


Addon Info
This addon is made by GekidoLukas, the creator of Weapon Leveling. All Issues regarding this addon are to be posted on this mod's issue page. Requesting another compatibility addon can be done via Weapon Leveling's issue page
